title: Standardized Documents and Compact Shot Conversion
notes: Adds one shared MithrilDocument contract for Drill Log and Shot Diagram snapshots, saving, restoring, refreshing, page numbering, and cloud synchronization.
Moves cloud upload and download through the shared document contract while remaining compatible with existing Firebase cloud records.
Removes the blue A-P and 1-34 coordinate labels from exported Drill Log PDF pages while keeping them visible inside the field application.
Adds Auto, keep, rotate right, rotate left, and rotate 180-degree choices when converting a Drill Log into a Shot Diagram, with page-count previews for each orientation.
Tiles only populated holes into the converted Shot Diagram, removes empty result pages, and numbers all resulting pages consecutively.
Renumbers remaining Drill Log and Shot Diagram pages after a page is deleted so page numbering never contains gaps.
